body:
m1 - CORRECTION TO MY OWN RECOMMENDATION, before you rule on it. I told you exclusion was the cheap option because "CostBreakdown already carries an exclusion field for exactly this". THE FIELD EXISTS; THE VALUE DOES NOT.

Exclusion is a single-case enum: `case Unreachable`, meaning "the candidate reference is not a node of the view" (cost.scala:160-162). That is a statement about the REFERENCE. What I need to express is "this node is in the view and we have no weighted evidence about it", which is a statement about the EVIDENCE. Reusing Unreachable would be a lie of exactly the kind this candidate exists to stop - and the one place it is used, CostBreakdown.unreachable at :256, pairs it with Double.MaxValue/4, so the semantics are load-bearing rather than decorative.

SO THE HONEST COST OF MY RECOMMENDATION is a new Exclusion case plus its wire handling, its codec enum decoder (align.scala:222), and another golden re-cut. That is not the one-field change I implied and you should price it accordingly.

WHAT I FOUND THAT MAKES IT MORE ATTRACTIVE ANYWAY: exclusion genuinely works mechanically. hsmm.scala:587 builds the state space as `collect { case (s, b) if !b.excluded => s }`, so an excluded cell is DROPPED FROM THE STATE SPACE rather than priced - it never competes with external at all. And HsmmResult.validated at :410 refuses any admitted state carrying an excluded record, so the invariant is already enforced in both directions. The machinery is there; only the vocabulary is missing.

THE PRECEDENT ALSO CUTS AGAINST MY EARLIER OBJECTION. I rejected "clamp to a large constant" as a magic number, but CostBreakdown.unreachable ALREADY DOES THAT - Double.MaxValue/4 - for the reference case. So the codebase's existing answer to "we cannot assess this" is exclusion PLUS a sentinel cost, and a second case following that pattern would be consistent rather than novel.

I HAVE NOT BUILT IT. Two options for you, priced honestly this time:
  (a) new Exclusion case, wire, codec, golden re-cut. Says the true thing; costs a schema change on
      top of the one you are already ruling on for hsmm/v1.
  (b) reject zero-weight-sum configurations at CostWeights.of. Much narrower, but I already told the
      scout it is insufficient - nonzero chart weight with zero dense weights still yields a
      chartless cell with zero present weight, so the hole survives in a narrower form.

My lean is still (a), but I was wrong that it was cheap, and if you were weighing my recommendation against its stated cost you were weighing the wrong number.
